message.content: A minimalist graphic representation of the flag of Japan, featuring a large, solid scarlet red circle perfectly centered on a plain, uniform white square background. The red circle, representing the sun, is clean-edged and dominates the center of the frame. There are no other objects, text, or textures present, resulting in a clean and symbolic composition. The lighting is even and neutral, typical of a graphic design.
